test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an election with two candidates, 8% of the registered voters did not vote, and 120 voters submitted blank ballots. Among the votes cast, the winning candidate received support from 48% of all registered voters and secured 780 more votes than the other candidate. Determine the total number of voters on the list.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total voters = x

Votes cast = 92% of x, valid votes = 0.92x − 120

Winner = 48% of x, loser = (0.92x − 120 − 0.48x)

Difference = 780 ⇒ 0.48x − (0.44x − 120) = 780

⇒ 0.04x + 120 = 780 ⇒ x = 16500

**∴ Answer = 16500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

8% did not vote, 120 blank votes, winner got 48% of total voters, winning margin = 780

**Formula used:**

Total votes cast = 92% of total voters

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total voters = x

⇒ Votes cast = 0.92x

⇒ Valid votes = 0.92x − 120

⇒ Winner votes = 0.48x

⇒ Loser votes = (0.92x − 120 − 0.48x) = 0.44x − 120

⇒ Difference = 0.48x − (0.44x − 120)

⇒ = 0.04x + 120

⇒ 0.04x + 120 = 780

⇒ 0.04x = 660

⇒ x = 16500

**∴ The correct answer is 16500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Vote Distribution Logic

Total voters include non-voters and blank votes, so adjust stepwise.

Percentage Conversion

Convert percentages into decimals for easier equation formation.

Margin Equation

Winning margin = winner votes − loser votes.
